items.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $6.3B in Q3 as BTC price rises nearly 43%
items.snippet: Bitcoin gained 42.71% in Q3, its best third-quarter performance since 2017, as US spot ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.

items.title: Bitcoin's soft-inflation pop to $85,500 fades as bond yields refuse to fall
items.snippet: A cooler-than-expected PCE report sent bitcoin briefly above $85,000 on Wednesday. Treasury yields held near their highest since 2002 and the gains drained away.
